DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID) with secondary pyelonephritis or urethritis.

The patient is a 17-year-old female with severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and dysuria. She reports dyspareunia (pain with intercourse) and inconsistent condom use. These findings, combined with the location of the pain and systemic symptoms, strongly suggest a sexually transmitted infection ascending to the upper genital tract. I will request a urine analysis, a pregnancy test, and a cervical swab for STI screening to confirm the diagnosis.
